Also, shipyards are working on a fleet of huge command ships, medium-size gunships, and fighters. In addition, many robots, such as remote/robotic attack fighters, mass-produced robotic/droid armies, and large robot assault machines, such as tanks and small submarines, are being made. Lastly, much large-scale weaponry is being produced, like huge nuclear cannons and missiles, gargantuan lasers, and a secret project called The Edcujm Project.

[quote=dhornaper;59786976][B]Outside the State Broadcaster[/b]
[I]Two hours later...[/i]

The drive to the state broadcaster was uneventful with few civilians encountered. General Fereydun radios Colonel Jamshid. "Has the air force been brought along, the Directorate of Intelligence neutralised, the other broadcasters prepared to relay the message, and the internet network service providers including our military network been occupied?" After a brief moment, Colonel Jamshid responds "Yes sir, all targets have been occupied and the broadcasters have been prepared to relay the message they receive from the state broadcaster."

With all targets secured, General Fereydun, Major Siamak, and their men got out of the truck just in front of the state broadcaster.

"Enter the building and stop anyone from coming in or getting out. Got it?" Orders General Fereydun. "Yes sir." Responds Major Siamak as he barks orders at his men to enter and secure the building and prevent any one from entering or leaving.

General Fereydun walks in with the enlisted soldiers and makes his way to the reception. "I need to talk with the director urgently, where is he?" He says arching down towards the receptionist. "Third floor room 40." The receptionist responds with a waver in their voice.

General Fereydun quickly makes his way to the director's office with two soldiers flanking him. When he arrives, he bursts in and demands to be taken to the news studio immediately to issue a national notice. The director doesn't have time to think it over as General Fereydun grabs him by the shoulder and forces him out of the door.

The nervous director guides General Fereydun to the news studio where the live broadcast is being shot. "Put it on hold, and prepare it so I can deliver an urgent message to the nation." The director hesitates before complying. The live broadcast is replaced with a message reading "This broadcast will be back in a few minutes..."[/quote]

[B]The Broadcast[/b]

General Fereydun looks straight into the camera with a stern face and delivers his message.

"Citizens, the armed forces has taken control of the administration of Dhornaper.

A transitionary government headed by the army has taken charge today. All Ministers of the dissolved government are to report themselves to the Army Headquarters immediately."

With that, the live broadcast ends. "Report on it constantly, play it over the radio channels as well, and set your web page to have this as the front news article" barks General Fereydun at the director.

With his broadcast aired, he leaves the building and radios Colonel Jamshid. "Have the broadcast aired and reported on constantly over television, civilian radio, and once over the military radio and get the broadcasters to put this at the front of their web pages. Shut off all network connectivity in five minutes, no matter what." "Yes sir" Colonel Jamshid radios back.

With that, General Fereydun gets back into the army truck on his own and makes his way to the Army Headquarters.

[B]On the Presidential Plane[/b]

President Kourosh and Ministers Emam and Jalayer are all tired from their long day in Hydronia. As they all nod off to sleep, a nervous looking flight attendant wakes them up rather irreverently.

"You need to see this." The flight attendant shows them his phone. "I had nothing to do so I checked my phone with the plane WiFi and saw this on the news." The headline of a Hydronian news article reads: "Army Takes Control of Dhornaper".

The President and his Ministers jolt awake and read the article in stunned silence. After a few minutes where no one says anything, the President takes out his phone and connects to the WiFi and attempts to call the Minister of Defence's office. The call fails. Getting desperate, he uses the onboard satellite phone and tries again.

[B]The Ministry of Defence[/b]

The Minister of Defence's satellite phone rings. Minister Dadras, however, is in no position to pick it up. The two soldiers with him in the room have detained him for over an hour and more soldiers surround his ministry's offices. He watches as the phone rings on his desk before it abruptly stops. His habit of working late in the office normally meant he could reliably contacted but today, forces outside his control have made him look unusually absent.

[B]On the Plane Again[/b]

President Kourosh holds his head in his hands as he waits for the call to Dadras to be picked up. After a minute, he cuts it and dials his Director of Intelligence.

[B]In the Director's Apartment[/b]

Director Alavi is sound asleep until he is woken up by the sound of his satellite phone ringing in the other room. Recognising its unique ring tone, he darts straight to it and picks it up.

"Hello President Koroush?"

"What is happening there? Why haven't you called me? The military is launching a coup and you're doing nothing?!"

Director Alavi is shocked. "Sir, a coup? I've been asleep."

"Turn on your television and look for yourself."

Alavi turns on his TV and watches the state broadcaster. On it, he sees the proclamation of General Fereydun on behalf of the army.

"Sir, I'll get the Directorate of Intelligence on it at once."

"Get moving!" is the response shouted back at him.

[B]Back on the Presidential Plane[/b]

President Koroush holds his head in his hands and he thinks over. His Minister of Defence is absent and his Director clueless. With no one else trustworthy he can contact in some position of power over the army, he has to wait as he approaches Dhornaper. According to the pilot, they should be near enough to make radio contact with the air force in approximately 30 minutes. Until then, he hopes that Director Alavi can organise a counter-coup and Minister Dadras can contact him.
